mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over 3 months signals active monetary easing, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines >0.2pp over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over 3 months signals labor market deterioration, triggering corporate earnings concerns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.2pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% and 0.3% growth respectively over 3 months indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth > 0.5% and RSAFS growth > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS growth exceed thresholds, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO) exceeding 1.0% annualized signals easing supply constraints, boosting manufacturing output and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2.5% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.5 percentage points over 6 months indicates monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% in 6 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3% and 0.1 percentage points respectively over 3 months indicates labor market strengthening, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.3% and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth >0.3% and UNRATE falls >0.1pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (defined by CPIAUCSL growth exceeding 3.0% annualized), rising inflation pressures lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to real interest rate increases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 3.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
